label: Employer Identification Number
description: A nine-digit number assigned by the IRS to identify a particular organization's account.

label: Primary Name of Organization
description: Legal non-profit name.

label: In Care Of Name
description: Person (officer, director, etc.) to whose attention any correspondence should be directed.

label: Street Address
description: Street address of the organization.

label: City
description: City where the organization is located.

label: State
description: State where the organization is located.

label: Zip Code
description: Postal code of the organization.

label: Group Exemption Number
description: A four-digit internal number assigned to central or parent organizations holding group exemption letters.

label: Subsection Code
description: Codes shown under section 501(c) of the Internal Revenue Code of 1986 that define the category under which an organization may be exempt.

label: Affiliation Code
description: Defines the organizational grouping.

label: Classification Code
description: Codes under section 501(c) defining the classification of the organization within a subsection.

label: Ruling Date
description: Month and year (YYYYMM) on the ruling or determination letter recognizing the organization's exempt status.

label: Deductibility Code
description: Signifies whether contributions made to the organization are deductible.

label: Foundation Code
description: Codes that differentiate between private foundations and public charities.

label: Activity Codes
description: Deprecated with the adoption of the National Taxonomy of Exempt Entities (NTEE) coding system in January 1995. Previously three activity codes (AAABBBCCC) described the organization's cause.

label: Organization Code
description: Indicates the legal structure of the nonprofit organization.

label: Exempt Organization Status Code
description: Defines the type of exemption held by the organization.

label: Tax Period
description: Tax period of the latest return filed (YYYYMM).

label: Filing Requirement Code
description: Indicates the primary return(s) the organization is required to file.

label: Private Foundation Filing Requirement Code
description: Indicates the primary return(s) the organization is required to file for private foundations.

label: Accounting Period
description: Designates the accounting period or fiscal year ending month (MM) of the organization.

label: Asset Amount
description: Total assets from the most recent Form 990 series return filed by the organization.

label: Income Amount
description: Total income from the most recent Form 990 series return filed by the organization.

label: Revenue Amount
description: Total revenue from the most recent Form 990 series return.

label: National Taxonomy of Exempt Entities (NTEE) Code
description: Code used to classify an exempt organization based on its primary exempt activity.

label: National Taxonomy of Exempt Entities (NTEE) General Group
description: A modifier used to describe activities in support of nonprofit organizations
